synchronous_v3_rebaseline.rebaseline_discrepancy_explanation: Sample c4691863 is 0/1 under canonical single-reference containment against 'DJ Lance Rock' (omitted suffix 'Rock'), but 1/1 under multi-answer alias matching in historical failure analysis. Historical and rebaseline generated answers were 100% byte-for-byte identical.

experiment_a_oracle_span.bounded_interpretation: Under the tested oracle-span intervention, 16 of 29 outcome-selected deficit cases became correct. The remaining cases were not recovered under this experimental setup. These observations characterize source-span recoverability; they do not establish mutually exclusive causal attributions for individual errors.
